keyPhrases.text: tender, joyous, bittersweet and very, very funny
perfect salve for an ugly world
the gift we didn't realize we desperately needed
could be taught in drama schools as a model of graceful exposition

reasoning: Strong rave review with superlative language throughout ('perfect salve,' 'superlative actors,' 'beautiful songs'). Minor acknowledgment of potential pitfalls ('booby traps,' 'grating quirks') but immediately countered by praise for how well they're handled. The opening and closing are particularly effusive, placing this in the high positive range.
